incidents-bot: [PAGER] High error rate & latency regression detected on canary - route=/v1/generate model=redwood-alpha-v2-q8 canary_group=canary-17 error_rate=7.8% (baseline 0.5%) p95=1900ms (+650ms). Triggered 2026-03-15T10:22:23Z. Paging oncall now.

Morgan (oncall): acked. I'm coming in. @Priya can you grab the canary vs control diff from console and tail the canary pods?

Priya (SRE): on it. Pulling canary logs and metrics now. Quick snapshot from Console: canary-17 requests=12k, errors=936, control errors ~60. Redispatching logs to thread.

Priya (SRE): logs excerpt from canary pod redwood-infer-17:
```
[2026-03-15T10:21:41Z] ERROR runtime: kv-cache OOM while merging kv for seq=1208
[2026-03-15T10:21:41Z] WARN  runtime: falling back to uni-batch path, latency spike
[2026-03-15T10:21:42Z] ERROR model: float32->q8 dequantize produced NaN at layer 23
```

Dan (ML Eng): whoa NaN on dequantize. That smells like quantization kernel edge-case for long sequences. What changed in this rollout? Which commit landed? @Automated Canary Bot can you dump the model artifact id for canary-17?

Automated Canary Bot: canary-17 artifact: redwood-alpha-v2-q8@sha256:9f8b3c4a (deployed 2026-03-15T09:55:00Z). Baseline/control artifact: redwood-alpha-v2-q8@sha256:5a1d2e11 (deployed 2026-03-08).

Dan (ML Eng): 9f8b3c4a includes a micro-optimization to the q8 dequant path (PR #4213) that touched vectorized kernels for layers > 20. Hypothesis: the micro-opt introduces precision drift for long KV lengths leading to NaN.

Elena (Product): how many customers hit a failure? any paid accounts impacted?

Sam (Customer Success): quick look: three paying customers had errors surface on production routes that hit canary traffic (they're on routing=region+percent). Affected endpoints: text-generate & chat-completions for long-seq workloads. I can open CS tickets and notify them, but need a mitigation path first.

Priya (SRE): mitigation plan options: 1) pause canary traffic (stop routing to canary-17), 2) roll back canary artifact to control sha, 3) disable the q8 quantized kernel path via runtime flag. Which do we prefer for fastest customer relief?

Morgan (oncall): prioritize fastest low-risk: pause canary routing immediately, then rollback artifact if metrics don't recover in 2 min. @Dan can you confirm rollback artifact id?

Dan (ML Eng): confirm rollback target: redwood-alpha-v2-q8@sha256:5a1d2e11 (last known-good). If pause doesn't clear errors, I'll trigger the artifact pin & rollout.

Priya (SRE): pausing canary routing now -> executed command:
```
# curl -X POST "https://console.internal/api/v1/route/update" -d '{"route":"/v1/generate","canary":"canary-17","weight":0}'
200 OK
```

Priya (SRE): observability: within 45s error rate dropped from 7.8% -> 1.0% (still above baseline). p95 dropped from 1900ms -> 850ms. Continuing to watch.

Sam (Customer Success): notifying affected customers with short update: "We've detected elevated errors on a canary model. We paused canary traffic and are monitoring. We'll follow up with ETA for full resolution." Will send once we have rollback or fix.

Priya (SRE): error volume trending down but still noisy. I'm going to initiate rollback now to be safe. Executing artifact pin for canary nodes to 5a1d2e11 and triggering redeploy.

Dan (ML Eng): issuing rollback:
```
# tools/rollout set-artifact --group canary-17 --artifact redwood-alpha-v2-q8@sha256:5a1d2e11 --force
Rolling out artifact 5a1d2e11 -> canary-17 (batch=3)
```

incidents-bot: Rollout started for canary-17 to artifact 5a1d2e11. Track: https://console.internal/rollouts/rollout-8271

Priya (SRE): canary pods are terminating and recreating with pinned artifact. tail of deploy logs:
```
[2026-03-15T10:26:12Z] Pod redwood-infer-17-0 terminating
[2026-03-15T10:26:28Z] Pod redwood-infer-17-0 started with artifact 5a1d2e11
[2026-03-15T10:26:55Z] Health check ok for redwood-infer-17-0
```

Priya (SRE): metrics now: errors -> 0.4% (baseline 0.5%), p95 -> 480ms. Looks recovered.

Morgan (oncall): excellent. I'm going to run a quick health sweep across canaries to ensure no other canaries have the micro-opt enabled. 

Dan (ML Eng): root-cause hypothesis: PR #4213 changed the stride alignment in q8 dequant vector kernel. For seq lengths > 1024 the misalignment produced a small number of NaNs which propagated and caused runtime error fallback + latency spikes. Repro: unit test with seq=1208 + specific attention mask reproduces NaN.

Dan (ML Eng): immediate fix: revert PR #4213 and add regression tests for long sequences and dequant stability. Long-term: add canary adversarial traffic generator to surface such pathologies during canary (simulate long-seq interactive sessions).

Elena (Product): customer impact summary for postmortem: a subset of long-sequence inference requests on canary routing experienced errors and increased latency between 10:21:40Z and 10:27:00Z. Affected customers: AcmeCorp, BrightDocs, and NovaSearch (all contacted by CS). No data exfiltration or integrity issues beyond request failures.

Sam (Customer Success): customers notified. AcmeCorp asked for ETA; gave them "we expect full resolution and a follow-up postmortem in 24-48 hours".

Priya (SRE): timeline so far (please correct times):
- 10:22:23Z incidents-bot alert (error rate anomaly)
- 10:23:00Z Morgan ack + triage started
- 10:23:20Z Priya pulls logs and confirms NaN dequant trace
- 10:24:00Z Dan identifies PR suspect (4213) and confirms artifact sha diff
- 10:25:30Z pause canary routing executed
- 10:26:15Z rollback initiated to artifact 5a1d2e11
- 10:27:20Z metrics back to baseline

Morgan (oncall): tagging follow-ups for the postmortem: action items ->
- Dan: revert PR #4213 + unit tests (owner: Dan)
- Eng Runtime: add runtime flag to disable q8 kernel at startup to enable fast mitigation (owner: Priya)
- DevEx/Canary: add adversarial long-seq traffic to canary suites (owner: Morgan + Dan)
- Product/CS: customer communications + postmortem summary (owner: Elena + Sam)
- Dedicated customers: verify model pinning doesn't auto-upgrade; audit policy for pinned artifacts (owner: Eng Platform)

Dan (ML Eng): note on Dedicated: I checked the Dedicated deploy policy - pinned deployments use artifact locking, but we found one Dedicated customer had a looser "float-minor" policy that allowed the micro-optimization to reach them. I'll surface a checklist to audit pinning rules.

Priya (SRE): preserving logs and artifacts for RCA. Archiving: s3://redwood-incident-logs/1789876543/ (logs, core dumps, metrics snapshots).

incidents-bot: Incident state -> RESOLVED (mitigated) at 2026-03-15T10:27:40Z. Duration: ~5m17s. Postmortem required.

Morgan (oncall): handing off to next oncall for postmortem work: @Dan will drive the RCA writeup, @Priya will attach ops timeline and logs. Next oncall please pick up for 10:30-18:30 shift.

Elena (Product): adding postmortem owners and expected delivery: initial RCA draft in 24 hours, full postmortem in 48 hours.

Sam (Customer Success): will follow up with customers once postmortem draft is ready.

Dan (ML Eng): final note: root cause = regression in quantization kernel (PR #4213). Remediation = revert + tests + canary adversarial traffic. I'll open PR to revert now and include a changelog.

Morgan (oncall): thanks team. closing thread once postmortem created. :thumbsup:
